user.title: Finanzverwaltung
user.description: Adds the “Schnellbuchung” (quick booking) entry to the sidebar. Requires the add-on “Private Finanzverwaltung”.

abort.kein_supervisor: Quick booking requires Home Assistant OS or Supervised because it embeds the add-on via Ingress.

alter_seitenleisten_eintrag.title: Old “Schnellbuchung” entry in configuration.yaml
alter_seitenleisten_eintrag.description: The integration now adds quick booking itself. The old entry from configuration.yaml is still present at {adressen}. Remove the panel_custom block with finanzen-schnellbuchung-panel there and delete config/www/finanzen-schnellbuchung.js. Then restart Home Assistant and this notice disappears.
